blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Nest retains issuer / admin authority over vault shares with permissioned issuance and freeze surfaces beyond reserve-only exposure.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: nOPAL has three reviewed independent native-issuance routes on Ethereum, Plume, and BSC. Nest's current registry and fixed-block supply reads establish three live native liability surfaces; the Plume and BSC rows retain Ethereum as the issuer's primary reference but are canonical native issuance, not peripheral bridge representations. No separate public bridge topology, OFT, lockbox, adapter, or destination-token mint role was identified.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-7 (lead pyusd-paypal); FIX2-09 Mint/Bridge boundary migration 2026-08-16
